name: Looking For Love
overview: Scripture reveals that true love is both powerful and transformative, capable of covering sins and resolving conflict, as Proverbs 10:12 teaches. This love originates from God’s sacrificial giving of His Son, offering eternal life to all who believe, according to John 3:16. Believers are called to actively embrace love, or charity, as the essential bond that perfects and unites them, as emphasized in Colossians 3:14.
